sections.title: Needs attention
sections.sql: SELECT code,title,owner,reason,review_on FROM attention_queue ORDER BY review_on NULLS FIRST,code

sections.title: Reviews due
sections.sql: SELECT code,title,owner,current_version,review_on FROM document_position WHERE status='active' AND (review_on IS NULL OR review_on<=current_date+7) ORDER BY review_on NULLS FIRST,code

sections.title: Filing register
sections.sql: SELECT code,title,class,owner,current_version,file_count,review_decision FROM document_position ORDER BY code

sections.title: Identical current files
sections.sql: SELECT example_file,documents,codes FROM duplicate_files ORDER BY codes

sections.title: Evidence checks
sections.note: Record checks only. A qualified owner decides retention and disposal. Nothing is deleted.
sections.sql: SELECT code,rule,finding FROM compliance_findings ORDER BY code,rule
